title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
description: Compared five classification models — logistic regression, a shallow neural network, random forest, gradient boosting, and linear SVC — to flag fraudulent credit card transactions. Addressed severe class imbalance with oversampling/undersampling, improving F1-scores from ~0.6–0.7 to ~0.91–0.94.
imageAlt: Grouped bar chart comparing F1-scores across five models on imbalanced vs. balanced data — every model improves substantially once the dataset is balanced

title: New York Taxi Analysis
description: Explored and modeled NYC taxi trip records end-to-end — cleaning, temporal feature engineering (pickup hour, day of week, seasonality), and comparing Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest with grid/randomized search and k-fold cross-validation. Random Forest generalized best, with the lowest test MSE and highest R².
imageAlt: Scatter plot comparing the model's predicted taxi fares to actual fares, showing a dense positive correlation along the diagonal

title: End-to-End Regression Pipeline for Market Price Forecasting
description: Built an end-to-end regression pipeline on the Boston housing dataset — EDA and preprocessing, feature scaling with StandardScaler, and a Linear Regression model — then deployed it behind a Flask web app for real-time price predictions, containerized with Docker.
imageAlt: Scatter plot of predicted vs. actual Boston housing prices, closely tracking the line of perfect prediction

title: Student Performance Indicator
description: Built a full ML pipeline — data ingestion, preprocessing (scaling + one-hot encoding), model training and evaluation, and versioned artifacts — to predict student math exam scores from demographic and academic features. Deployed as an interactive Flask web app.
imageAlt: Scatter plot with a fitted regression line showing predicted math scores closely tracking actual math scores

title: Real Estate Price Prediction
description: Linear regression model predicting Bangalore property prices from location, square footage, BHK count, and bathrooms, with outlier removal and one-hot encoding, served through a Flask + JavaScript web app.
